messages.content:
/sub <prompt>  - spawn a sub-agent to run task in background
/sub-list      - list all sub-agents
/sub-view <id> - view full output of a sub-agent
/new           - start a new session (clear history)
/exit, /quit   - exit briar
Ctrl+C         - cancel current request
Ctrl+D         - exit briar
↑ ↓            - scroll messages
